audit_metadata.hardware: Jerry's PC, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5080, WebGPU 1080p pipeline

weapons.name: Combat Pistol
weapons.sight_obs: Front blade and rear notch align dead-center on reticle axis; no sightline obstruction.
weapons.receiver_slide_obs: Clean slide top fluting; bevelled muzzle crown; ejection port contour cleanly defined.
weapons.hammer_mechanism_obs: Exposed hammer properly modeled and textured; slide serrations crisp at 40 cm.
weapons.magwell_obs: AG-209 seating crop confirms bevelled magazine basepad sits completely flush against frame bevel.
weapons.material_scale_obs: Matte parkerized dark steel finish; uniform texel density at 1080p and 1440p; no camo pop (J63).
weapons.z_fighting_obs: Zero z-fighting across slide rails, extractor pin, or barrel chamber hood.
weapons.four_light_obs: Audited in Noon, Overcast, Dusk, Night in AG-206; highlights pick out slide bevels cleanly.

weapons.name: Magnum Revolver
weapons.sight_obs: Slightly understated front blade against wide rear notch (Defect 2); reticle alignment centered at ADS.
weapons.receiver_slide_obs: Hip yaw +0.40 candidate rotates cylinder and barrel side into clean 3D silhouette, curing AG-206 backplate block look.
weapons.hammer_mechanism_obs: Fluted 6-shot cylinder, crane pivot arm, and cocked spur hammer fully articulated.
weapons.magwell_obs: Cylinder crane swing-out and ejector star stroke verified in AG-207 reload (revolver-reload-1080p.jpg).
weapons.material_scale_obs: Polished blued steel with satin sheen; micro-scratches visible at close distance; steady texel scale.
weapons.z_fighting_obs: Zero z-fighting along top barrel rib, cylinder flutes, or frame screws.
weapons.four_light_obs: AG-209 4-light comparison confirms distinct specular ridge highlights across all 4 times of day.

weapons.name: Wasp SMG
weapons.sight_obs: Aperture sight wings frame front post; top cocking handle offset cleanly leaves central sightline clear (D-91 order).
weapons.receiver_slide_obs: Stamped sheet-metal receiver ribs, folding stock hinge, and barrel nut clearly detailed.
weapons.hammer_mechanism_obs: Bolt face visible through ejection port; charging handle slot properly proportioned.
weapons.magwell_obs: Stick magazine seats flush into pistol grip housing; verified via AG-209 seating crop.
weapons.material_scale_obs: Phosphate finish with slight edge wear; consistent texel density; robust low-reflection tone.
weapons.z_fighting_obs: Zero z-fighting between top cover latch, sight protector wings, or barrel collar.
weapons.four_light_obs: Audited in AG-206; stamped metal ribs maintain depth under flat overcast and dusk moon.

weapons.name: GW-4 Rifle
weapons.sight_obs: A2 front sight post centered in flat-top optic rail channel; sight picture clear and unobstructed.
weapons.receiver_slide_obs: Picatinny upper receiver rail, brass deflector, forward assist, and dust cover crisply defined.
weapons.hammer_mechanism_obs: Charging handle latch sits flush against upper receiver; birdcage flash hider detailed at muzzle.
weapons.magwell_obs: Flared magwell cleanly accepts STANAG 30-round magazine; AG-209 seating crop shows flush fit with zero gap.
weapons.material_scale_obs: Anodized aluminum receiver and ribbed polymer handguard textures scale accurately; no J63 camo pop.
weapons.z_fighting_obs: Zero z-fighting between upper/lower receiver split line, rail cuts, or delta ring.
weapons.four_light_obs: Audited in AG-195 and AG-206; raking dusk light emphasizes handguard ribbing.

weapons.name: KR-7 Rifle
weapons.sight_obs: Tangent rear sight notch aligns precisely with hooded front sight post; clear field of view down range.
weapons.receiver_slide_obs: Ribbed dust cover, selector lever notch, gas tube collar, and muzzle slant brake distinct.
weapons.hammer_mechanism_obs: Right-side bolt carrier and reciprocating charging handle cleanly separated from receiver body.
weapons.magwell_obs: Curved 7.62 steel magazine locks cleanly into front pivot catch; AG-209 crop confirms locked engagement.
weapons.material_scale_obs: Laminated wood handguard grain and stamped dark metal receiver texture render with natural fidelity.
weapons.z_fighting_obs: Zero z-fighting between receiver cover ribs, gas block, or magazine latch.
weapons.four_light_obs: Audited in AG-195 and AG-206; directional sun creates crisp cast shadows across receiver fluting.

weapons.name: Remington 870
weapons.sight_obs: Vent rib barrel and front brass bead cleanly define aiming plane; receiver backplate reads wide at ADS.
weapons.receiver_slide_obs: Candidate yaw +0.25 (AG-209) reveals side receiver contour and ejection port, resolving flat backplate look.
weapons.hammer_mechanism_obs: Grooved pump slide and steel action bars articulate smoothly; tubular magazine cap detailed.
weapons.magwell_obs: Under-receiver loading gate verified in AG-207 reload (tubular magazine design; no detachable box mag).
weapons.material_scale_obs: Dark blued finish with subtle edge highlights; textured fore-end grip holds high texel scale.
weapons.z_fighting_obs: Zero z-fighting between barrel rib supports, magazine tube bracket, or trigger guard.
weapons.four_light_obs: AG-209 4-light comparison confirms candidate +0.25 yaw reads distinctly in Noon, Overcast, Dusk, and Night.

weapons.name: Breacher-12
weapons.sight_obs: Elevated combat ghost-ring rear and post sight sit proud above chassis; clear sight picture.
weapons.receiver_slide_obs: Candidate yaw +0.25 exposes drum circumference and side housing, breaking up massive flat polymer back.
weapons.hammer_mechanism_obs: Internal bolt mechanism with side charging track; heavy recoil buffer tube enclosure.
weapons.magwell_obs: 20-round rotary drum magazine seats firmly into lower chassis channel; AG-209 seating crop confirms fit.
weapons.material_scale_obs: Reinforced matte polymer body with stainless steel barrel insert; uniform texel density.
weapons.z_fighting_obs: Zero z-fighting across clamshell seam, sight brackets, or drum latch.
weapons.four_light_obs: AG-209 4-light comparison proves candidate drum silhouette holds up across all four sky illumination states.

weapons.name: Scout Sniper
weapons.sight_obs: High-magnification telescopic optic with reticle crosshairs; ADS eye-relief at 11.8 cm creates realistic optic bezel.
weapons.receiver_slide_obs: Bolt-action receiver with turned-down bolt handle, heavy fluted barrel, and threaded muzzle brake.
weapons.hammer_mechanism_obs: Cock-on-open bolt cocking piece visible at receiver rear; smooth bolt cycling path.
weapons.magwell_obs: 5-round single-stack box magazine seats flush into floorplate magwell; confirmed in AG-209 crop.
weapons.material_scale_obs: Dark grey composite stock with textured grip panels; anodized scope tube; clean texel scale.
weapons.z_fighting_obs: Zero z-fighting between optic ring mounts, Picatinny base, or fluted barrel contours.
weapons.four_light_obs: Audited in AG-206; scope lens reflections and tube specular gleam respond accurately to lighting.

weapons.name: Chainsaw
weapons.sight_obs: Guide bar points directly up screen center per Jerry J60 directive; no traditional sight post.
weapons.receiver_slide_obs: Two-stroke engine block, wrap-around tubular support bar, chain brake lever, and side exhaust port.
weapons.hammer_mechanism_obs: Recoil pull cord housing, sprocket drive cover, and individual saw tooth cutters cleanly modeled.
weapons.magwell_obs: Integral gasoline motor with fuel reservoir cap; no detachable magazine (correctly marked N/A).
weapons.material_scale_obs: Weathered industrial enamel on engine housing, bare steel cutter bar with grease wear marks.
weapons.z_fighting_obs: Zero z-fighting across guide bar chain track, wrap handle mounts, or muffler heat shield.
weapons.four_light_obs: Audited in AG-206; chrome chain tooth bevels catch directional sun and moon rims.

weapons.name: Flamethrower
weapons.sight_obs: Nozzle hood low center-right; flame projection line converges with screen center; sightline clear.
weapons.receiver_slide_obs: Dual propellant tubes, perforated heat dissipation sleeve, regulator valve wheels, and igniter head.
weapons.hammer_mechanism_obs: Twin pilot flame brackets and spark electrode; 1P stream emergence verified in AG-212 (0m lateral offset).
weapons.magwell_obs: Integral fuel tank / pressure hose connection; reload animation not authored (marked UNVERIFIED).
weapons.material_scale_obs: Brass fittings, scorched heat-tempered steel nozzle, and matte canister coating.
weapons.z_fighting_obs: Zero z-fighting between perforated barrel shroud, gas lines, or regulator clamps.
weapons.four_light_obs: Audited in AG-206 and AG-212; nozzle thermal sheen and flame bloom illuminate surrounding geometry.

weapons.name: Grenade Launcher
weapons.sight_obs: Folding leaf quadrant sight legibly raised in ADS; reticle center completely clear at muzzle NDC (0.038, -0.165).
weapons.receiver_slide_obs: Candidate yaw +0.25 (AG-214) exposes 6-chamber rotary cylinder fluting and crane latch in 3D perspective.
weapons.hammer_mechanism_obs: Heavy double-action trigger guard, cylinder indexing ratchet, and forward crane pivot clearly separated.
weapons.magwell_obs: Revolving cylinder chamber; individual 40mm grenade reload animation not in stage 2/3 (marked UNVERIFIED).
weapons.material_scale_obs: Parkerized military finish on barrel and frame; rubberized rear butt plate; clean texel scale.
weapons.z_fighting_obs: Zero z-fighting along barrel cylinder interface, leaf sight hinges, or cylinder flutes.
weapons.four_light_obs: AG-214 4-light comparison (Noon, Overcast, Dusk, Night) confirms rotary cylinder depth across all conditions.

weapons.name: Rotary Minigun
weapons.sight_obs: ADS sightline blocked by carry handle / motor housing (Defect 1; explicitly HELD pending Grokbot J18 reflex dot).
weapons.receiver_slide_obs: 6-barrel cluster, dual barrel clamp collars, heavy electric drive motor housing, and ammo chute receiver.
weapons.hammer_mechanism_obs: Spade grip handle assembly, electric motor wiring harness, and flexible metallic feed chute.
weapons.magwell_obs: Continuous feed chute from backpack ammunition hopper; no detachable magazine (correctly marked N/A).
weapons.material_scale_obs: High-density gunmetal and manganese phosphate finish; barrel heat patina holds detail at 40 cm.
weapons.z_fighting_obs: Zero z-fighting across rotating barrel bundle, clamp rings, or motor housing seams.
weapons.four_light_obs: Audited in AG-206; cylindrical barrel cluster specular highlights transition smoothly through day/night cycle.

defects.description: ADS view is obstructed by the heavy carry handle and electric drive motor housing at y 0.300-0.320. Held pending Grokbot GB-259 J18 reflex red dot.
Front sight post reads slightly subtle against wide rear notch under low-contrast Dusk/Night lighting conditions.

defects.weapon: long_guns (m4, ak, shotgun, aa12, sniper, launcher)
defects.description: Long guns at rest are held somewhat end-on and upright (steep perspective angle). Handed over to GP-20018 for side-on shouldered placement.
